description:
Stop the cargo-ci self-test's wrong-nextest-version fixture hanging on a host whose `cargo` is a shim that resolves the real cargo through `PATH`.

## Background

`scripts/cargo-ci-selftest.sh` `test_wrong_nextest_version_fails_fast` puts a fake `cargo` first on `PATH`; its `--version` branch execs the `cargo` resolved earlier by `command -v`. On a host where that is a PATH-scanning shim, the shim finds the fake again, so the two exec each other forever. The self-test then holds the shared CI locks until its gate timeout.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The fixture answers `cargo --version` without re-entering `PATH` resolution, so `./scripts/cargo-ci-selftest.sh` finishes on a host whose `cargo` is a PATH-scanning shim.
- [hard] REQ-02: The wrong-nextest-version case asserts what it asserted before.
title: cargo-ci self-test fixture does not loop through a cargo shim
